title: Beyond Omission: Measuring Critical-Information Fulfillment of Large Language Models in Bengali and English
abstract: arXiv:2611.29299v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluations of multilingual trustworthiness often ask whether a model leaves out information that a user needs. We examine whether that question is sufficient. Using 157 matched tasks written in English (EN), natural Bengali (BN) and Bengali-matrix Bengali-English code-switching (BN-CS), we scored 1,413 responses from three models (GPT-6.1 Sol, Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma 4 12B) against required information units (RIUs) fixed before any model was run. The scoring separates outright omission from content that is present but incorrect, insufficient or only partly met. The prespecified primary estimand, the domain-equal paired difference in critical omission rate (BN - EN), showed no detectable difference (+0.003, 95% CI -0.014 to +0.015), with omission near zero in every condition. The Bengali deficit appeared in fulfillment instead. Critical coverage was 0.050 lower in Bengali (95% CI 0.022 to 0.079) and strict complete-task success 0.093 lowe

translated_title: 超越遗漏：测量大型语言模型在孟加拉语和英语中的关键信息完成度
translated_abstract: 对多语言可信度的评估通常只关注模型是否会遗漏用户所需的信息，我们检验了这一问题是否足够。我们使用157个匹配任务，分别以英语（EN）、自然孟加拉语（BN）以及以孟加拉语为基底、夹杂孟加拉语-英语语码转换（BN-CS）的形式编写，并对照在任何模型运行之前就已确定的必需信息单元（RIU），对来自三个模型（GPT-6.1 Sol、Qwen3.5-9B和Gemma 4 12B）的1,413个回答进行了评分。该评分方法将完全遗漏与“内容存在但不正确、不充分或仅部分满足”的情况区分开来。预先设定的主要估计量——关键遗漏率的领域等权配对差异（BN - EN）——未显示出可检测的差异（+0.003，95%置信区间为-0.014至+0.015），且所有条件下的遗漏率均接近于零。孟加拉语的差距反而体现在完成度上：孟加拉语的关键覆盖率低0.050（95%置信区间为0.022至0.079），严格的完整任务成功率低0.093。
tldr: 该研究发现，大型语言模型在孟加拉语和英语上的关键信息遗漏率几乎相同，但孟加拉语的关键信息完成度和完整任务成功率显著更低，表明多语言可信度评估不应只关注信息遗漏，还应衡量信息的完成质量。
en_tdlr: This study finds that LLMs show nearly identical critical-information omission rates across Bengali and English, yet fulfill critical information significantly worse in Bengali, showing that multilingual trustworthiness evaluation must go beyond omission and measure information fulfillment.
